title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From silent library mezzanines to sun-drenched art terraces, Biola University offers a range of environments for deep focus and collaborative projects.

cards.title: Silent Study in the Mezzanine
cards.subtitle: Biola University Library
cards.notes: Located on the upper level, this mezzanine area is a designated silent study zone ideal for distraction-free reading and research.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent study space located on the mezzanine level of the main university library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Biola Library Reading Room/Mezzanine is a designated silent study space.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces - About the Library - Biola University
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; requires a valid Biola ID for entry.

cards.title: Fresh Air on the Library Terrace
cards.subtitle: Biola University Library
cards.notes: Enjoy Southern California weather at these outdoor tables located just outside the library entrance for a breezy study session.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor study area featuring tables and seating located adjacent to the Biola University Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Biola Library Outdoor Study Terrace is listed as an outdoor study space.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces - About the Library - Biola University
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 as an outdoor campus space; no reservation required.

cards.title: Elevated Views at Bardwell Hall
cards.subtitle: Bardwell Hall
cards.notes: This rooftop space in the renovated art building provides a modern environment with views across the heart of the campus.
cards.short_summary: A rooftop terrace located atop Bardwell Hall, providing outdoor study and exhibition space for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Bardwell Hall features a rooftop terrace as part of its renovated facilities.
cards.source_title: Studios & Facilities: Department of Art - Biola University
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; primarily serves Art and Design students but accessible to the community.

cards.title: Science-Focused Group Study
cards.subtitle: Alton and Lydia Lim Center
cards.notes: Utilize modern collaborative zones within the 91,200-square-foot science facility, designed for group projects and peer learning.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative study areas located within the Alton and Lydia Lim Center for Science, Technology and Health.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lim Center includes collaborative spaces for students to learn and experiment.
cards.source_title: Alton and Lydia Lim Center for Science, Technology and Health - Biola University
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; features high-tech amenities for science students.

cards.title: Quiet Reading by the Water
cards.subtitle: Talbot East
cards.notes: Find focus near the soothing sounds of the hidden fountain in the Talbot East courtyard, a favorite for theology students.
cards.short_summary: A quiet outdoor courtyard featuring a fountain, located within the Talbot School of Theology complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The Talbot Fountain is a hidden fountain in Talbot East used by students for reading and discussion.
cards.source_title: My Favorite Places to Study on Campus - Becoming Biola
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor area on the south side of campus.

cards.title: Late Night Study Fuel
cards.subtitle: Student Union Building (SUB)
cards.notes: This cozy lounge offers a social study atmosphere with coffee and smoothies, staying open late for evening productivity.
cards.short_summary: A coffee lounge and study space located on the east patio of the Student Union Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Common Grounds is a coffee lounge used for late-night study fuel.
cards.source_title: On Campus Dining Locations - Biola University
cards.access_notes: Open seven days a week; check current hours for late-night closing times.

cards.title: Deep Focus in the Stacks
cards.subtitle: Biola University Library
cards.notes: Head to the lower level for individual cubicles that provide a secluded environment for intense, focused homework sessions.
cards.short_summary: Individual study cubicles located on the lower level of the university library, known for a quiet atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The library's lower level features cubicles that help students focus.
cards.source_title: My Favorite Places to Study on Campus - Becoming Biola
cards.access_notes: Requires Biola ID for library entry; cubicles are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

cards.title: Eco-Friendly Study Nook
cards.subtitle: Blackstone Hall
cards.notes: Located at the newest dorm, this cafe patio offers a modern, green-certified space for students living on the north side of campus.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor patio and cafe area located at Blackstone Hall, providing a study space away from the campus center.
cards.evidence_claim: Blackstone Hall features its own fully-functional cafe and two patios for residents and visitors.
cards.source_title: What Blackstone Means to Me - Becoming Biola
cards.access_notes: Accessible to the Biola community; located approximately 10 minutes from the campus center.

cards.title: Business School Breakout
cards.subtitle: Crowell School of Business
cards.notes: Tucked inside the business building, this unique cafe provides a professional yet relaxed setting for networking and study.
cards.short_summary: A cafe and study area located within the Crowell School of Business building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Talon is a unique cafe located in the corner of the business building.
cards.access_notes: Open during business building hours; popular for quick meetings between classes.

cards.title: Collaborative Project Hubs
cards.subtitle: Biola University Library
cards.notes: Book these rooms up to two weeks in advance for two-hour blocks; they feature whiteboards and presentation screens.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for group collaboration located on the upper and lower levels of the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Study rooms are available for reservation by students for up to two hours per day.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Study Room - Library - Biola University
cards.access_notes: Reservations recommended via LibCal; rooms are not soundproof.
